output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS churned_customers FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01') > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01') = 0) AS c
output.explanation: Counts customers with at least one completed order (is_revenue) dated in 2024 and none dated in 2025. Years are based on order_date.
